**Did.** Finished PMPP chapter 5. Tiled matmul cuts global-memory reads by a
factor of the tile width $T$: each input element is loaded $n/T$ times
instead of $n$ times.

**Learned.** For an $n \times n$ matmul the arithmetic intensity is

$$
\frac{2n^3 \text{ FLOPs}}{3n^2 \times 4 \text{ bytes}} = \frac{n}{6} \text{ FLOP/byte},
$$

so big matrices are compute-bound, not memory-bound.

**Next.** Profile it in Nsight Compute.
